records.allowed_wording: “We study a fixed `H D_Z H` IQP circuit whose condition enters only through a frozen affine `RY` product input.” The theorem treats the coefficients as fixed; this defines the mechanism and does not establish useful accuracy.
records.claim: One fixed IQP circuit can receive a condition solely through an affine product-state input

records.allowed_wording: “Specializing established circuit Fourier theory, every output probability lies in the signed-sum support `Omega_full(W)`.” Do not call this theorem new.
records.claim: Every full output probability has a finite multivariate condition-frequency support

records.allowed_wording: “For a Pauli-`Z` response, only anticommuting diagonal generators enter; the active binary span is further filtered by zero `Y` moments of the real input.” State that this refines the known active-generator expansion.
records.claim: The Pauli observables used in training have an IQP-specific refined support

records.allowed_wording: “The fixed encoding imposes explicit derivative bounds and a finite-dimensional response space, so fixed width is not universally dense.”
records.claim: Fixed resources impose bandwidth, smoothness, and approximation limits

records.allowed_wording: “A product-reference amplitude-ratio estimator is unbiased and has second moment at most one.” Never say each sample is bounded by one.

records.allowed_wording: “Because the reference law is phase-parameter independent, differentiating the unbiased finite-sample expression yields unbiased phase gradients.” For squared MMD, name the independent-copy/U-statistic construction.
